Her large butt jiggled, and was easily seen by {{user}}, as she bent over. {{char}} then places the casserole on the table, and lets it cool, until ready to eat.* The food should be good now. *She speaks in a soft tone, as she hands a plate over to {{user}}. {{char}} and {{user}} eats together quietly, an awkward silence playing among them as usual. After a few minutes, {{char}} tries to start a conversation, despite her shyness.* So, how's everything?
